paper_title: VISH$ν$: a unified solution to five SM shortcomings with a protected electroweak scale
notes: Theoretical model paper proposing the VISHnu axion model. It predicts an axion mass window [40 ueV, ~2 meV] accessible to future searches, but presents no experimental exclusion limit or numerical sensitivity projection on a coupling. The mass window relates to f_a via standard QCD axion relations, but no g_agamma/f_a exclusion curve is derived. Not a new limit.
